meta.name: baoyu-compress-image
meta.description: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩图片为 WebP 或 PNG 格式，减小文件体积
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要压缩图片或转换格式来节省空间
copy.tagline_en: Compress images to WebP or PNG to reduce file size
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compress images or convert formats to save space

howto.what: 装上后，当你请 Claude 压缩或优化图片时，它会输出 WebP（默认）或 PNG 图片，并自动选一个可用的压缩工具来执行；你也能指定格式、质量，或让它一次处理整个文件夹。
howto.when: 当用户要求压缩或优化图片、把图片转成 WebP，或减小图片文件大小时触发。

say.text: 把我发的这张图压缩成 WebP。
say.note: 会按默认质量生成 WebP 文件。

say.text: 把 images 目录里的图片全压缩，质量 75，包含子文件夹。
say.note: 会对目录及其子目录做批量压缩。

say.text: 把这张 JPG 转成 PNG，并保留原文件。
say.note: 会保留原 JPG，另存一份 PNG。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask Claude to compress or optimize an image, it outputs a WebP (default) or PNG copy, automatically selecting one of the available tools. You can also request a specific format, quality, or a whole folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to compress or optimize images, convert images to WebP, or reduce an image file’s size.

say_en.text: Compress this image I just sent to WebP.
say_en.note: Produces a WebP file with default quality.

say_en.text: Compress all images in the images folder at quality 75, including subfolders.
say_en.note: Batch-processes the directory and its subdirectories.

say_en.text: Convert this JPG to PNG and keep the original file.
say_en.note: Keeps the original JPG and writes a PNG copy.
